source_datasets.notes: Eight regions plus the Sector Autónomo de Bissau, one-decimal column percentages, six categories (including a large ND non-response share), no counts. The prose in section 3.4.2 misstates two table values (Oio Muçulmana 47,1 vs table 42,1; Gabú/Bafatá order); Quadro 4 is internally consistent and is trusted. No percentage was altered.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)
indicators.description: Share of the Guinean-nationality resident population in the four affiliation categories (Animista, Muçulmana, Cristão, Outra Religião).
indicators.method: Sum of the four published affiliation-category one-decimal shares from Quadro 4, rounded to one decimal. ND (não declarado) and Sem religião stay outside this numerator. No count is derived from any percentage.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Eight ADM1 regions plus the Sector Autónomo de Bissau on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary; the census frame matches the boundary units one-to-one (B. Bijagós -> Bolama, SAB -> Bissau by documented concordance).
indicators.quality_notes: One-decimal published column percentages of the Guinean-nationality universe (1,442,227 of 1,449,230 household residents). ND is 10,5-25,7% by region; affiliation + no religion + ND = 100 within the derived 0,30 pp bound.

indicators.label: No religion (%)
indicators.description: Sem religião as a share of the Guinean-nationality resident population.
indicators.method: The published Sem religião one-decimal share from Quadro 4, carried unchanged.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Eight ADM1 regions plus the Sector Autónomo de Bissau on the geoBoundaries 2017 boundary; the census frame matches the boundary units one-to-one (B. Bijagós -> Bolama, SAB -> Bissau by documented concordance).
indicators.quality_notes: Sem religião is a real non-affiliation category inside the denominator and outside the affiliation numerator; distinct from the ND non-response category.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation share
visual_layers.description: Census religious affiliation share by region, 2009.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: Muslim-majority east (Gabú 86,5%, Bafatá 77,1%) contrasts with the animist/ Christian west and islands (Biombo animist 40,1%, Bolama/Bijagós Christian 30,7%, Bissau Christian 40,2%). A large ND non-response share (10,5-25,7%) sits outside both metrics.

visual_layers.label: No religion share
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: published regional value on the 2017 boundary
visual_layers.notes: Single wave; no cross-wave change layer (subnational religion is published for 2009 only).

rows.population_total_basis: INE RGPH-2009, Características socioculturais, Quadro 4: religion by region as one-decimal column percentages of each region's Guinean-nationality resident population. The source publishes percentage shares only, with no regional counts; population_total and all counts are therefore null; percentages are shipped as printed. National counts (Quadro 3/5) are recorded as context and are not multiplied into the shares (no derived-count layer).
